response.sql: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_average FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_average) AS country_average FROM race_averages GROUP BY country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(country_average) AS benchmark FROM country_averages), above_overall AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.country_average FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ca.country_average > o.benchmark), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(country_average) AS benchmark FROM above_overall) SELECT a.country, a.country_average, a.country_average - o.benchmark AS above_overall_benchmark, a.country_average - s.benchmark AS above_second_mean FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN second_mean AS s WHERE a.country_average > s.benchmark
